workflow.name: System Design Workflow
workflow.purpose: Turn a short Intake, project authority material and user opinions into a System Design that explains what problem is solved, why the design is shaped this way, and how fitness for the current project is proven. The only success terminal is IMPLEMENTATION_READY; budget exhaustion or missing external authority enters recoverable INCOMPLETE, explicit cancellation enters CANCELLED, and non-retryable execution/configuration failure enters FAILED; none of the three equals success.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle marker written by each Action result; last write wins.

fields.name: routing
fields.description: Per-Action routing result consumed by the graph's conditional edges; overwritten by the most recent Action result.

fields.name: return_action
fields.description: SD-11 validated return_action (SD-09 | SD-13 | SD-14) selected from the invalidated validation evidence of the Revision Request; Runtime validates it against origin and invalidation state; SD-09 is not the unconditional default.

fields.name: evidence_return_action
fields.description: Recorded resume_action of the Evidence Research Request (SD-05 | SD-09); Runtime persists the return binding, the Evidence Scout cannot change it.

fields.name: resume_lens
fields.description: Affected SD-09 lens (PROBLEM_SOLUTION | ARCHITECTURE | QUALITY_ACCEPTANCE) recorded when evidence research returns to SD-09; research resumes only that fresh recheck before aggregation resumes.

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Admitted review Findings appended across review iterations; severity/disposition is decided by the source lens and never overwritten.

fields.name: review_signals
fields.description: Non-blocking REVIEW_SIGNAL records; never counted as Findings, never block, never trigger Human Decision admission.

fields.name: aggregation
fields.description: SD-10 aggregation result: { routing, mergedFindings, contradictions }; the routing value drives the conditional edges of node.sd-10.

fields.name: brief
fields.description: Immutable Confirmed Design Brief artifact reference with run-workspace content digest and topic identities.

fields.name: skeleton
fields.description: Confirmed System Design Skeleton artifact reference; architecture direction and technical feasibility closed.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Versioned complete Draft artifact reference in the ignored run workspace, suitable for independent review.

fields.name: design
fields.description: Final System Design candidate bound at SD-15 to the exact content and dependency closure in Workflow state.

fields.name: grilling_questions
fields.description: Budget accounting for grilling questions (budget.questions); accumulated with the sum reducer.

fields.name: research_attempts
fields.description: Budget accounting for evidence research attempts (budget.research); accumulated with the sum reducer.

fields.name: feasibility_iterations
fields.description: Budget accounting for architecture-feasibility iterations (budget.feasibility); accumulated with the sum reducer.

fields.name: review_iterations
fields.description: Budget accounting for review iterations (budget.review); accumulated with the sum reducer.

fields.name: revision_count
fields.description: Budget accounting for targeted revisions (budget.revision); accumulated with the sum reducer.

fields.name: decision_turns
fields.description: Budget accounting for human decision dialogue turns (budget.decision-dialogue); accumulated with the sum reducer.

terminals.meaning: Only success terminal: Confirmed Design Brief frozen; Skeleton architecture direction and technical feasibility closed; the complete Design passed three mutually independent adversarial reviews; Blocking/Major Findings closed by their corresponding lens and Minor Findings closed or explicitly accepted by the source lens; all design-owned feasibility and parameter questions closed; every downstream obligation owner-complete with return location and design-reopen condition; Fresh Reader Test and deterministic verification passed; final Design bound to exact Git/artifact identity and not stale; necessary lineage/decision/review conclusions absorbed; session artifacts cleaned and the Git candidate set free of workflow intermediates.

Resumable stop: budget exhausted or external authority missing; records current artifact identities, closed topics, unresolved issues, remaining Findings/Spikes, stop reason, resume Action and required input/budget; preserves state and never relaxes a Gate; resumable from recorded state.
Explicit durable cancellation; preserves required lineage per retention policy (in Runtime state, not in Git); cannot be reported as INCOMPLETE or success.

Non-retryable configuration/execution failure; terminates with current artifacts and failure evidence; cannot be converted to INCOMPLETE to allow silent substitution; requires a new authorized Delivery.

waits.purpose: WAITING_FOR_USER during adaptive grilling: persists the pending question identity, evidence binding and dialogue history; only a correlated answer bound to the same question identity may resume the same working Brief.

expiry.policy: renewal allowed through the recorded Action; otherwise resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request; never success and never silent cancellation

waits.purpose: WAITING_FOR_USER until explicit whole-Brief confirmation: Runtime persists the wait, validates identity and freezes the artifact; an answer bound to another Brief version cannot freeze this version; follow-up remains allowed until explicit confirmation.

expiry.policy: renewal allowed through the recorded Action; otherwise resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request; never success and never silent cancellation

waits.purpose: WAITING_FOR_USER for the multi-turn Human Decision Dialogue: persists the pending decision identity, evidence binding, dialogue history and exact resume_action; resumable only within the same admitted decision identity and evidence binding; questions and exploratory replies are never interpreted as final decisions; exit only with an explicit Human Decision Record.

expiry.policy: renewal allowed through the recorded Action while policy/budget permits; otherwise resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request; never success and never silent cancellation

waits.purpose: WAITING_FOR_SPIKE for architecture-feasibility evidence: persists the exact Spike Request identity and content digest, external execution correlation, deadline Gate and exact resume_action; mismatched or duplicate results cannot advance state; a valid result is validated against its exact request, environment, method and evidence binding before being applied.

expiry.policy: deadline Gate: renewal resumes the recorded Action to publish the same or a new versioned request while permitted; otherwise resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request; never success and never silent cancellation

waits.purpose: WAITING_FOR_SPIKE for design-owned parameter evidence: persists the exact Spike Request identity and content digest, external execution correlation, deadline Gate and exact resume_action; mismatched or duplicate results cannot advance state; only a result whose request, environment, method and evidence satisfy the request contract may close the parameter.

expiry.policy: deadline Gate: renewal resumes the recorded Action to publish the same or a new versioned request while permitted; otherwise resumable INCOMPLETE with the pending request; never success and never silent cancellation

handoffs.domainSemantics: Downstream obligation (SD-12 register): records identity, accountable owner, affected design identities, semantic dependency, required evidence, return location and design-reopen condition. Contract publication of frozen design semantics may remain open for the consuming Workflow to classify and publish; this Delivery does not choose the downstream Action, Gate, Wait or terminal, and the record never declares them.
handoffs.invalidationConditions: A later change to the frozen Design or to the referenced authority identities invalidates the recorded prerequisite.
handoffs.semanticDependency: Published Contract semantics must preserve the frozen design semantics; unexecuted downstream evidence is never reported as passed evidence.
handoffs.requiredEvidence: Contract publication or authoritative reference with exact content identity.
handoffs.returnLocation: Consuming Workflow return location recorded in the downstream obligation register.
handoffs.reopenCondition: A published fact contradicts the frozen design semantic dependency.

handoffs.domainSemantics: Downstream obligation (SD-12 register): records identity, accountable owner, affected design identities, semantic dependency, required evidence, return location and design-reopen condition. Implementation feasibility obligations are explicit downstream handoffs; their lifecycle classification, Action, Gate and terminal impact are owned by the consuming Workflow.
handoffs.invalidationConditions: A later change to the frozen Design or to the implementation baseline invalidates the recorded feasibility expectation.
handoffs.semanticDependency: Implementation feasibility evidence must be produced by the current implementation and bound to exact content identities, never assumed or substituted.
handoffs.requiredEvidence: Implementation feasibility evidence with exact content identity.
handoffs.returnLocation: Consuming Workflow return location recorded in the downstream obligation register.
handoffs.reopenCondition: A measured implementation fact contradicts the frozen design semantic dependency.

handoffs.domainSemantics: Downstream obligation (SD-12 register): records identity, accountable owner, affected design identities, semantic dependency, required evidence, return location and design-reopen condition. Implementation verification obligations are explicit downstream handoffs; the consuming Workflow owns the lifecycle classification and terminal impact.
handoffs.invalidationConditions: A later change to the frozen Design or to the verification scope invalidates the recorded verification claim.
handoffs.semanticDependency: Implementation verification evidence must be produced by the current implementation, not assumed or substituted.
handoffs.requiredEvidence: Implementation verification result with exact evidence identities.
handoffs.returnLocation: Consuming Workflow return location recorded in the downstream obligation register.
handoffs.reopenCondition: A measured implementation fact contradicts the frozen design semantic dependency.

handoffs.domainSemantics: Downstream obligation (SD-12 register): records identity, accountable owner, affected design identities, semantic dependency, required evidence, return location and design-reopen condition. Runtime tuning parameters may close during test/runtime validation; measured facts that violate design assumptions reopen the design through the recorded reopen condition.
handoffs.invalidationConditions: A measured runtime fact that violates a frozen design assumption invalidates the affected design content.
handoffs.semanticDependency: Runtime tuning values are parameters, not passed design evidence; the design-reopen condition governs when a value reopens the design.
handoffs.requiredEvidence: Measured runtime value with method, owner and return location.
handoffs.returnLocation: Consuming Workflow return location recorded in the downstream obligation register.
handoffs.reopenCondition: A measured fact violates design assumptions stated in the design-reopen condition.
